notes: Accounts and cloud sync: sign in under Menu → Account and your projects follow you to any phone or browser. Using it without an account works exactly as before.
A coloured dot before the project name shows where your latest edit stands — green in the cloud, orange waiting, red needs attention.
Edited on two devices? Nothing is overwritten: both versions are kept, the other one as “… (cloud copy)”.
Projects → History restores earlier versions; Account → Recently deleted brings back projects deleted in the last 90 days.
There is no password reset — keep your password safe. Settings → Back up everything saves a file copy of every project.
The Projects list now counts items across every panel, not just the first.
